chunks: Hajj performed while riding is better than performing it on foot, because the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed Hajj while riding.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better or more excellent in merit
key_terms.ٱلْحَجُّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Is performing hajj while riding better than walking?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing hajj while riding is superior to performing it on foot. The reason given is the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, making it a proof drawn from his sunnah (prophetic tradition).
